course.title: Unit 4 Why don’t you talk to your parents?【例句】

sentences.content: What’s wrong?
sentences.english: What's wrong ?
sentences.chinese: 怎么了？

sentences.content: My sister borrows my clothes without asking.
sentences.english: My sister borrows my clothes without asking
sentences.chinese: 我妹妹总是不问一声就借走我的衣服。

wordDetails.definition: borrow（第三人称单数现在时）: 借

sentences.content: What should I do?
sentences.english: What should I do ?
sentences.chinese: 我该怎么办？

sentences.content: Well, you could tell her that this makes you angry so she’ll ask you next time.
sentences.english: Well , you could tell her that this makes you angry so she'll ask you next time
sentences.chinese: 你可以告诉她这让你很生气，这样下次她就会先问你了。

sentences.content: I don’t have any friends at my new school.
sentences.english: I don't have any friends at my new school
sentences.chinese: 我在新学校一个朋友都没有。

sentences.content: What should I do?
sentences.english: What should I do ?
sentences.chinese: 我该怎么办？

sentences.content: Although you don’t have any now, you will soon make some.
sentences.english: Although you don't have any now , you will soon make some
sentences.chinese: 尽管你现在一无所有，但很快你就会有所收获。

sentences.content: I’m worried about my school grades.
sentences.english: I'm worried about my school grades
sentences.chinese: 我很担心我的学习成绩。

sentences.content: What’s your advice?
sentences.english: What's your advice ?
sentences.chinese: 你有什么建议？

sentences.content: You shouldn’t wait until the last minute to study for a test.
sentences.english: You shouldn't wait until the last minute to study for a test
sentences.chinese: 你不应该等到最后一刻才去准备考试。

sentences.content: Mike is my best friend, but he always copies my homework.
sentences.english: Mike is my best friend , but he always copies my homework
sentences.chinese: Mike是我最好的朋友，但他总是抄我的作业。

wordDetails.definition: copy（第三人称单数）: 复制

sentences.content: What should I do?
sentences.english: What should I do ?
sentences.chinese: 我该怎么办？

sentences.content: Although he’s your best friend, you should still tell him that copying others’ homework is wrong.
sentences.english: Although he's your best friend , you should still tell him that copying others' homework is wrong
sentences.chinese: 尽管他是你最好的朋友，你也应该告诉他抄袭别人的作业是不对的。

sentences.content: My best friend is more popular than me.
sentences.english: My best friend is more popular than me
sentences.chinese: 我最好的朋友比我更受欢迎。

sentences.content: I want to be like him.
sentences.english: I want to be like him
sentences.chinese: 我想成为像他那样的人。

sentences.content: What should I do?
sentences.english: What should I do ?
sentences.chinese: 我该怎么办？

sentences.content: You could try to be friendlier.
sentences.english: You could try to be friendlier
sentences.chinese: 你可以试着更友善一些。

sentences.content: You should just be yourself.
sentences.english: You should just be yourself
sentences.chinese: 你应该做你自己。

sentences.content: These days, many parents push their children into learning more skills.
sentences.english: These days , many parents push their children into learning more skills
sentences.chinese: 如今，许多父母都逼迫孩子学习更多技能。

sentences.content: They believe it helps their kids to better compete in life.
sentences.english: They believe it helps their kids to better compete in life
sentences.chinese: 他们认为这有助于他们的孩子在生活中更具竞争力。

wordDetails.definition: help（第三人称单数）: 帮助

sentences.content: However, such a busy life can place great pressure on students.
sentences.english: However , such a busy life can place great pressure on students
sentences.chinese: 然而，如此繁忙的生活会给学生带来巨大压力。

sentences.content: The Taylors are a typical American family.
sentences.english: The Taylors are a typical American family
sentences.chinese: Taylor一家是典型的美国家庭。

sentences.content: Life for Cathy Taylor’s three children is very busy.
sentences.english: Life for Cathy Taylor's three children is very busy
sentences.chinese: Cathy Taylor的三个孩子生活非常忙碌。

sentences.content: “On most days after school,” Cathy says, “I take one of my two boys to basketball practice and my daughter to football training.
sentences.english: " On most days after school ," Cathy says ," I take one of my two boys to basketball practice and my daughter to football training
sentences.chinese: Cathy说：“大多数放学后的日子，我都会带两个儿子中的一个去参加篮球训练，再带女儿去参加足球训练。”

wordDetails.definition: say（第三人称单数现在时）: 说

sentences.content: Then I have to take my other son to piano lessons.
sentences.english: Then I have to take my other son to piano lessons
sentences.chinese: 然后我还得送另一个儿子去上钢琴课。

sentences.content: Maybe I could cut out a few of their activities,
sentences.english: Maybe I could cut out a few of their activities
sentences.chinese: 或许我可以减少他们的几项活动,

sentences.content: but I believe these activities are important for my children’s future.
sentences.english: but I believe these activities are important for my children's future
sentences.chinese: 但我相信这些活动对我孩子们的未来至关重要。

sentences.content: I really want them to be successful.”
sentences.english: I really want them to be successful ."
sentences.chinese: 我真心希望他们能成功。

sentences.content: However, the tired children don’t get home until after 7:00 p.m.
sentences.english: However , the tired children don't get home until after 7:00 p . m
sentences.chinese: 然而，疲惫的孩子们直到晚上7点以后才回到家。

sentences.content: They have a quick dinner, and then it’s time for homework.
sentences.english: They have a quick dinner , and then it's time for homework
sentences.chinese: 他们匆匆吃完晚饭，接着就到了做作业的时间。

sentences.content: Linda Miller, a mother of three, knows all about such stress.
sentences.english: Linda Miller , a mother of three , knows all about such stress
sentences.chinese: 三个孩子的母亲Linda Miller深知这种压力。

wordDetails.definition: know（第三人称单数）: 知道

sentences.content: “In some families, competition starts very young and continues until the kids get older,” she says.
sentences.english: " In some families , competition starts very young and continues until the kids get older ," she says
sentences.chinese: 她说：“在一些家庭中，竞争从孩子很小的时候就开始了，并一直持续到他们长大。”

wordDetails.definition: start（第三人称单数）: 开始
continue（第三人称单数）: 继续

sentences.content: “Mothers send their small kids to all kinds of classes.
sentences.english: " Mothers send their small kids to all kinds of classes
sentences.chinese: 母亲们把小孩送去上各种各样的课。

sentences.content: And they are always comparing them with other children.
sentences.english: And they are always comparing them with other children
sentences.chinese: 他们还总是拿他们和其他孩子作比较。

sentences.content: It’s crazy.
sentences.english: It's crazy
sentences.chinese: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.content: I don’t think that’s fair.
sentences.english: I don't think that's fair
sentences.chinese: 我认为这不公平。

sentences.content: Why don’t they just let their kids be kids?
sentences.english: Why don't they just let their kids be kids ?
sentences.chinese: 为什么他们就不能让孩子们做回孩子呢？

sentences.content: People shouldn’t push their kids so hard.”
sentences.english: People shouldn't push their kids so hard ."
sentences.chinese: 人们不该对孩子逼得太紧。

sentences.content: Doctors say too much pressure is not good for a child’s development.
sentences.english: Doctors say too much pressure is not good for a child's development
sentences.chinese: 医生表示，过多压力不利于儿童的成长发育。

sentences.content: Dr. Alice Green says all these activities can cause a lot of stress for children.
sentences.english: Dr. Alice Green says all these activities can cause a lot of stress for children
sentences.chinese: Alice Green博士表示，所有这些活动都可能给孩子们带来很大压力。

sentences.content: “Kids should have time to relax and think for themselves, too.
sentences.english: " Kids should have time to relax and think for themselves , too
sentences.chinese: 孩子们也应该有时间放松和独立思考。

sentences.content: Although it’s normal to want successful children, it’s even more important to have happy children.”
sentences.english: Although it's normal to want successful children , it's even more important to have happy children ."
sentences.chinese: 尽管望子成龙是人之常情，但让孩子拥有快乐童年更为重要。
